caption: The drawing depicts a wooden frame saw, consisting of two vertical wooden handles that are roughly cylindrical and slightly tapered, connected near the top and bottom by two horizontal wooden bars. The top horizontal bar is attached to the vertical handles using cord or rope, which is wrapped tightly around the joints and tied off at each end. A thinner, vertical wooden piece runs downward from this top bar to the lower horizontal bar near the center. The bottom horizontal bar of the frame is actually a saw blade, metallic in color, with a jagged row of teeth along its bottom edge for cutting. Both ends of the blade are set into the wooden handles, with the left side showing a portion of the blade protruding from the handle. The wooden parts of the saw frame are brown with visible grain texture, while the blade is a dull metallic gray. The rope is a light tan color. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small, handwritten label at the bottom center of the image, which includes cursive script.
title: Coopersmith Saw
